name: ReimbursementClaim
description: Tracks the 50/50 cost split between the sending bank and the receiving PSP under PSR PS23/3. Created by SVC-009 (Domestic Payments) on consumption of FraudReimbursementApproved (EVT-092). SVC-009 owns this entity because it is the FPS scheme participant responsible for all interactions with Pay.UK and the receiving PSP. One ReimbursementClaim per FraudCase (one-to-one). Receiving PSP recovery status tracked from Pay.UK claim submission through to resolution. Introduced by JRN-005.

fields.name: claim_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated by SVC-009. Immutable.

fields.name: case_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK reference → FraudCase.case_id (ENT-043, SVC-013). Cross-service reference. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: total_reimbursed_amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. GBP. Equal to FraudCase.reimbursement_amount from EVT-092 payload. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: sending_bank_share
fields.validation_rule: Required. total_reimbursed_amount * 0.5. GBP. Updated to reflect actual net cost after recovery.

fields.name: receiving_bank_share
fields.validation_rule: Required. total_reimbursed_amount * 0.5. GBP. Amount claimed from receiving PSP.

fields.name: receiving_bank_sort_code
fields.validation_rule: Required. 6-digit UK sort code. Sourced from PaymentExecution.receiving_sort_code (ENT-009). Used to identify receiving PSP for Pay.UK claim.

fields.name: receiving_bank_fps_participant_id
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. FPS scheme participant ID of receiving PSP. Resolved from Vocalink EISCD. Required for Pay.UK reimbursement claim submission.

fields.name: pay_uk_claim_reference
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Pay.UK claim reference assigned on submission. Max 35 chars. Null until submitted.

fields.name: recovery_status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: pending | partial | full | failed | disputed. Transitions: pending → partial | full | failed | disputed. Terminal states: full | failed.

fields.name: recovery_amount
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. GBP. 0.00 on creation. Updated as funds received. Cannot exceed receiving_bank_share.

fields.name: claim_submitted_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Timestamp of Pay.UK claim submission.

fields.name: recovery_resolved_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Set when recovery_status transitions to terminal state.

fields.name: dispute_escalated
fields.validation_rule: Required. Default false. Set true when recovery_status = disputed and escalated to Pay.UK dispute resolution (EX-002). Requires PER-059 authorisation.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Updated on each recovery_status change.

relationships.description: ReimbursementClaim belongs to one FraudCase via case_id FK. Cross-service reference — FraudCase data read via SVC-013 API.
ReimbursementClaim is associated with the original PaymentExecution. SVC-009 owns both — can join internally via payment_intent_id chain.
